description: This file contains unit tests for the InvestOriginRepository class, verifying CRUD operations and exception handling related to InvestOrigin entities.

methods.name: testExceptionOnGetByInvestId

methods.description: Creates and persists a new InvestOrigin entity, then verifies that it has been stored.

methods.name: testInvestOriginExists
